note: Hand-curated project briefs on real public sources (GitHub, Kaggle, public data). Skills use taxonomy.json names. Each criterion tests one skill; the review jury checks each criterion against the repo. Nothing here is a score.

projects.title: Sales warehouse on the Olist e-commerce dataset

criteria.text: A SQL query joins 3 or more of the Olist tables
The tables load into PostgreSQL with keys and at least one index
A Python script loads the CSV files and rejects bad rows
A Dockerfile or docker-compose file starts the database and the loader

projects.twist: Make the loader safe to run twice: a second run adds no duplicate rows.

projects.title: Daily NYC taxi pipeline with Airflow and dbt

criteria.text: An Airflow DAG downloads one month of trip data and loads it
dbt models build a daily trips table with tests on keys
A SQL model counts trips and fares per zone and day
Python code checks row counts before and after the load
docker-compose starts Airflow and the database

projects.twist: Re-running a past day replaces that day only and leaves other days as they were.

projects.title: Fix a good-first-issue in Apache Airflow

criteria.text: The pull request changes Python code for the issue and links the issue
The change adds or updates a test for the Airflow behaviour it fixes

projects.twist: Explain in the pull request why your fix is better than the other option you tried.

projects.title: Analytics models with tests on the jaffle shop data

criteria.text: dbt staging and mart models for orders and customers
A SQL mart computes customer lifetime value
A profile or README shows the models run on Snowflake

projects.twist: Add a dbt test that fails on a real data problem you found, and explain it.

projects.title: Customer churn model with a clear evaluation

criteria.text: Python code cleans the data and splits train and test sets
A model is trained and compared with a simple baseline on the test set
A SQL query or notebook cell summarises churn by contract type

projects.twist: Show one case where the model is wrong and say why.

projects.title: Train and serve a PyTorch image classifier

criteria.text: A PyTorch training loop with a validation step
Results report accuracy per class on held-out images
A Python API returns a prediction for an uploaded image
A Dockerfile builds and runs the API

projects.twist: Make the API reject files that are not images with a clear error.

projects.title: Question answering over a project's docs (RAG)

criteria.text: Docs are split into chunks and stored with embeddings
Answers retrieve chunks first and cite which chunk they used
An LLM call builds the answer from the retrieved text only
A Python test checks one known question gets the right source

projects.twist: When no chunk is relevant, the app says it does not know instead of guessing.

projects.title: REST API in Go with PostgreSQL and tests

criteria.text: Go handlers create and resolve short links
Links are stored in PostgreSQL with a unique index on the code
A Dockerfile builds a small image of the service

projects.twist: Two requests for the same long URL return the same short code.

projects.title: Deploy a service to Kubernetes with Terraform

source.label: Brief · deploy any small web service

criteria.text: Kubernetes manifests or a Helm chart with a Deployment, a Service and readiness probes
Terraform creates the cluster or its network
A Dockerfile builds the service image
The Terraform targets AWS (EKS or VPC resources)

projects.twist: A rolling update replaces pods with no failed requests; show how you checked.

projects.title: React dashboard over a public API

source.label: Brief · any open public API (e.g. data.gov.my)

criteria.text: React components show a table and a chart from the API
TypeScript types describe the API response
A small Node.js server caches the API calls

projects.twist: Show a clear message when the API is down, not a blank page.

projects.title: Habit tracker app in React Native

criteria.text: React Native screens to add habits and tick them per day
TypeScript types for habits and a test for the streak count

projects.twist: Ticks made offline are kept and shown after the app restarts.
